articles.title: Denmark 2-0 Wales: Craig Bellamy's side bottom of Nations League group after second defeat in a row
articles.summary: Report as Wales suffer second consecutive Nations League defeat after conceding two set-piece goals against Denmark; Mikkel Damsgaard delivered the cross for both as Ben Davies' own goal and Gustav Isaksen's deflected strike sealed the win for Denmark in the second half
articles.body:
Both of Denmark's goals came from set pieces delivered by Brentford midfielder Mikkel Damsgaard with Ben Davies turning into his own net shortly after the break before Gustav Iskasen's deflected strike put the game beyond doubt.

Wales were second best throughout and could have been behind in the first half with Damsgaard striking the post from range moments after Isaksen had a volley ruled out by VAR for a marginal offside from Rasmus Hojlund in the build-up.

Craig Bellamy's depleted side battled to a 1-0 defeat against Portugal in Lisbon on Thursday but they were utterly outclassed by Denmark in Copenhagen in a result that paints a bleak picture for their hopes in Nations League Group A4.

Wales have failed to register a single goal or point in their first two games and they face an uphill battle if they are to avoid relegation from this group.

Denmark were under similar pressure after being beaten by Norway on Thursday, and there was turmoil in the camp after captain Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg openly questioned the team's tactics, but they rose to the occasion and could easily have won more comfortably.

Wales have no let up as they face Norway and Erling Haaland on Thursday in their third Nations League match. Norway play Portugal later on Sunday before that match.

articles.title: Agredidos un árbitro de 19 años y su padre en un partido juvenil en Zaragoza
articles.standfirst: La Asociación Española de Árbitros de Fútbol (Aesaf) ha condenado lo ocurrido: "Tolerancia cero frente a la violencia contra el arbitraje"
articles.summary: La Asociación Española de Árbitros de Fútbol (Aesaf) ha condenado lo ocurrido: "Tolerancia cero frente a la violencia contra el arbitraje"
articles.body: La Asociación Española de Árbitros de Fútbol (Aesaf), sindicato que agrupa a los árbitros de Primera y Segunda División y de la Liga F, ha condenado la agresión sufrida por un el árbitro Yago García Aparicio, de 19 años, en el encuentro Pina-La Unión, correspondiente a Primera Juvenil, disputado ayer, sábado, en la localidad de Pina de Ebro (Zaragoza). La Aesaf ha condenado de forma "rotunda" el incidente que tuvo lugar en la recta final del partido tras el gol que ponía el marcador 3-4 a favor del equipo visitante, informa la entidad en un comunicado emitido este domingo. En ese momento, se desencadenó la invasión del terreno de juego y el árbitro fue agredido, al igual que su padre, y tuvo que recibir asistencia médica. Aesaf, sindicato que se constituyó en junio de 2025 para defender a la figura arbitral, reclama "tolerancia cero frente a la violencia contra el arbitraje" y una respuesta firme, coordinada y ejemplar por parte de todos los organismos con competencias en la competición". También recuerda la recomendación de que se denuncie cualquier agresión ante las Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad del Estado y se aporte el parte médico y las pruebas disponibles.

articles.title: Shock ahead of Portugal vs Norway as Bruno Fernandes withdrawn for Haaland clash, coach Jorge Jesus explains why
articles.summary: Bruno Fernandes will miss the crucial UEFA Nations League match against Norway due to an injury, as coach Jorge Jesus prioritizes recovery ahead of important fixtures.
articles.body: Bruno Fernandes will miss Portugal's UEFA Nations League meeting with Norway on Sunday after Jorge Jesus decided not to risk the Manchester United captain, who has been playing through an injury problem. Fernandes started and played the full 90 minutes in Portugal's 1-0 win over Wales earlier this week, but was absent from training on Saturday after telling Jesus that he has been carrying pain through his last three games for United.Fernandes will not be risked in OsloFernandes' absence became clearer after he was left out of Portugal's official matchday squad for the trip to Oslo, with UEFA rules allowing a maximum of 23 players to be named.The 32-year-old had already emerged as a concern after the Wales game, when he came through the full match despite the problem. Jesus said the Portugal medical team had identified Fernandes as one of the players requiring particular attention, with the midfielder needing treatment and recovery time rather than another demanding match so soon after the previous one.“The other case [Fernandes] involves treatment and recovery time,” Jesus said, as quoted by Metro.“He’s coming off an injury at United, and he told me he’s been playing with that pain for the last three games, which is hindering him.”Jesus believes that issue affected Fernandes' performance against Wales, even though Portugal eventually secured a 1-0 victory in Lisbon.“It was one of the factors that prevented Bruno from playing at his best against Wales,” he said.The Portugal manager had already hinted that Fernandes was likely to sit out the Norway fixture, explaining that the short recovery period between matches made it difficult to justify taking the risk.“In the game against Wales, we went in with all the available players but Bruno Fernandes came off with a complicated problem,” Jesus said.“We’ll see what happens until tomorrow. Experience tells me that on the third day not all players manage to recover but that’s the same for Norway as for us. However, the player who comes in gives as many guarantees as the one who might come off, that’s what I’ll base my decision on.”With Fernandes now left out of the squad, Jesus' intention is clear: Portugal would rather have their captain properly recovered for what comes next.“I’ve already spoken to him and I prefer not to risk it in this game so he’s fully fit for the Denmark match,” Jesus added.Portugal face a Norway side coming off a big winPortugal head to Oslo with three points already secured, but Norway will arrive with plenty of confidence of their own after opening their Nations League campaign with a 3-2 victory over Denmark.Erling Haaland was the difference in that match, scoring twice as Norway held on for an important home win.That makes Fernandes' absence an important selection issue for Jesus, particularly with Portugal having to deal with a short turnaround after the Wales match. The manager also provided an update on Nuno Mendes, who had been another concern, saying the Paris Saint-Germain defender could be available.“The medical team identified these two players as the most concerning, Nuno Mendes could be available for the game,” Jesus said.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. El Mundial de ciclismo 2026, en directo:

El interés por la batalla entre los mejores ciclistas del planeta en Canadá ha aumentado de manera exponencial su temperatura tras el histórico doblete de Benjamín Noval en el Mundial de Montreal 2026, donde se impuso tanto en la contrarreloj como en la prueba en ruta de categoría júnior. Ante la ausencia del intratable Tadej Pogacar debido a su caída en LaVuelta, la pugna por el maillot arcoíris se recrudece y varios son los candidatos a heredar la corona del esloveno

La carrera en línea masculina que cerrará la competición se presenta como un desafío colosal de 273,4 kilómetros, con 3.803 metros de desnivel positivo y un perfil singular . La jornada comenzará en Brossard y finalizará en Montreal, comenzando con un tramo llano y plácido entre campos y ríos.

Sin embargo, el escenario cambiará drásticamente al adentrarse en la principal ciudad de Quebec , donde aguarda el exigente circuito de Mont-Royal. Los corredores deberán completar 1 2 vueltas a este trazado de 13,4 kilómetros, el cual acumula 269 metros de desnivel por vuelta y cuenta con rampas que alcanzan hasta el 11% de inclinación. La meta en Parc Jeanne-Mance coronará al nuevo arcoíris

En la prueba en línea masculina, la selección española estará liderada por el flamante ganador de LaVuelta, Enric Mas y Juan Ayuso, quienes al frente del combinado nacional compartirán filas con Markel Beloki, Iván Romeo, Carlos Verona, Marcel Camprubí, Raúl García Pierna e Igor Arrieta.

articles.title: Is Mike Evans playing today? Injury update, fantasy advice for 49ers WR in Week 3
articles.summary: The veteran receiver is listed as questionable ahead of the matchup with the Cardinals.
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers have enough issues with injuries, but there was one more added to the list last week in wide receiver Mike Evans .

Evans sustained a hip injury that forced his early exit from the Week 2 win over the Miami Dolphins .

The 49ers wideout was only able to turn in a single limited practice this week, and he has drawn the questionable tag ahead of kickoff on Sunday afternoon.

Here's the latest update on Evans' status for the contest against the Arizona Cardinals .

Aug 13, 2026; Santa Clara, California, USA; San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans (5) watches from the sideline during a game against the Tennessee Titans in the fourth quarter at Levi's Stadium. Credit: David Gonzales-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

Evans is expected to play against the Cardinals in Week 3, according to ESPN's Jeremy Fowler , who reported so on Sunday morning.

"49ers WR Mike Evans (questionable, hip) plans to play for the 49ers on Sunday vs Arizona, per source," Fowler wrote.

This was pretty much the expectation all along, even after Evans' questionable tag.

Head coach Kyle Shanahan said after the Week 2 game that Evans could have closed out the contest if it was closer, so the 49ers held him out as a precaution more than anything else.

Sep 11, 2026; Melbourne, AUS; San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans (5) makes a touchdown catch over Los Angeles Rams cornerback Jaylen Watson (35) in the second half at Melbourne Cricket Ground. Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters)

Through two weeks of the 2026 season, Evans has nine catches for 103 yards and a touchdown.

According to Fantasy Pros , he ranks as WR22 overall with those numbers, which puts him on the map as a flex option on a weekly basis.

This week, Evans draws a matchup against a Cardinals defense that is tied for the third-most fantasy points per game allowed to wide receivers.

Arizona is also surrendering two touchdowns per game to the position, which is tied for the most in the NFL. That's important to note because of Evans' lackluster yardage totals.

Slot Evans in as a flex option in Week 3.

articles.summary: El Deportivo Cali Femenino ratificó su hegemonía en el fútbol colombiano al coronarse campeón de la Liga Femenina BetPlay 2026. En un electrizante encuentro disputado en el estadio de Palmaseca, las Azucareras superaron 4-2 a Independiente Santa Fe en el partido de vuelta de la gran final, sellando un impecable marcador global de 7-4 a su favor.
articles.body: El Deportivo Cali Femenino ratificó su hegemonía en el fútbol colombiano al coronarse campeón de la Liga Femenina BetPlay 2026. En un electrizante encuentro disputado en el estadio de Palmaseca, las Azucareras superaron 4-2 a Independiente Santa Fe en el partido de vuelta de la gran final, sellando un impecable marcador global de 7-4 a su favor. Con esta victoria, el conjunto vallecaucano logra su tercer título consecutivo y suma la cuarta estrella de su historia, consolidando un dominio absoluto frente a las Cardenales, a quienes han derrotado por tercera final consecutiva. Aunque las locales salieron con ímpetu impulsadas por la ventaja conseguida en el juego de ida, fue Santa Fe quien dio el primer golpe. En el minuto 14, Mariana Zamorano sorprendió con un espectacular remate desde media distancia —a casi 40 metros del arco— que venció a la guardameta Maryory Sánchez e igualó temporalmente la serie global. Tras un tiro de esquina y una salida en falso de la arquera bogotana Wendy Martínez, Melanin Aponzá tomó un rebote en el área y puso el 1-1 en el marcador. Más tarde, Ingrid Guerra aprovechó una recuperación alta de Karla Viancha para definir con categoría al palo derecho, enviando al Cali al descanso con el 2-1 a favor. En el arranque del complemento, un centro peligroso terminó en gol en propia puerta de la defensora santafereña Izabella Cortés, estirando la ventaja a 3-1. Zamorano volvió a aparecer para las Leonas, superando a las centrales rivales para colocar el 3-2 y mantener viva la esperanza capitalina. Ya en el tiempo de adición, Ingrid Guerra coronó su actuación con una formidable jugada individual, dejando atrás a dos rivales en velocidad y sellando el 4-2 definitivo para desatar la fiesta verde en Palmaseca. El encuentro también dejó un momento de preocupación al minuto 78, cuando la jugadora de Santa Fe, Daniela Garavito, debió ser retirada en camilla tras sufrir una lesión en su rodilla derecha. Tras la consagración, ambos planteles pondrán la mirada en la Copa Libertadores Femenina 2026, que se disputará en Ecuador a partir del 15 de octubre:

articles.title: El “Valencia, ¡buah!” de Javier Aguirre tiene un origen: así sufría Mestalla con Osasuna, Atlético, Espanyol y Mallorca
articles.standfirst: El mexicano, encantado con su reto de entrenar al Valencia y de ver cómo 49.000 espectadores van, esta vez, a su favor porque sabe cómo es el ambiente de Mestalla
articles.summary: El mexicano, encantado con su reto de entrenar al Valencia y de ver cómo 49.000 espectadores van, esta vez, a su favor porque sabe cómo es el ambiente de Mestalla
articles.body: Javier Aguirre rechazó cuatro equipos, entre ellos selecciones de fútbol, pero cuando el Valencia llamó, no tuvo dudas. Ninguna. Valencia es un histórico al que no puede decir que ‘no’ esté como esté y llegó el momento de una toma de decisión que llegó rápido. Es la oportunidad para cerrar su etapa como entrenador. Pero nada más aterrizar en Valencia dejó una expresión que dice mucho. “Valencia, buah… era un fortín”. Esa frase resume todo lo anterior. No cabe de gozo. Quiere sentir como local el fortín que sentía como visitante. Y lo quiere gozar como parte de su ‘equipo’. Pero, ¿cómo han sido las visitas de Aguirre a Mestalla? El técnico mexicano ha dirigido a un rival de Mestalla en diez ocasiones. Y lo ha sufrido. El balance son dos victorias, dos empates y seis derrotas. Los dos triunfos llegaron con Osasuna y con el Mallorca. Por partes. La primera victoria fue con el equipo rojillo (0-1) en la 2003-04, la del doblete del Valencia. Su segundo triunfo fue con el Mallorca y teniendo como protagonista a Kangin Lee tras derrotar a los locales (1-2). Los dos empates fueron con el Espanyol (2-2) y con el Mallorca (0-0), mientras que perdió en seis ocasiones. De esas derrotas, tres fueron con el Atlético de Madrid. Estaba abonado a sufrir un 3-1 en cada una de sus visitas al feudo blanquinegro en uno de los grandes clásicos de la Liga. Curiosamente con el Zaragoza y con el Leganés, clubes los que dirigió mediadas temporadas, no tuvo la ocasión de sufrir la presión de Mestalla.

articles.title: El médico de Las Palmas le salva la vida a un pasajero en el aeropuerto de Gran Canaria
articles.standfirst: Diosdado Bolaños auxilió al hombre tras desplomarse repentinamente
articles.summary: Diosdado Bolaños auxilió al hombre tras desplomarse repentinamente
articles.body: La expedición de Las Palmas se vio envuelta en un inesperado episodio antes de poner rumbo al País Vasco. El equipo amarillo, que juega esta tarde ante el Eibar en Ipurua, viajó ayer a Bilbao. Mientras el equipo esperaba su vuelo en el aeropuerto de Gran Canaria, los médicos del club tuvieron que intervenir de urgencia para atender a un pasajero que sufrió un ictus cerca de la puerta de embarque de su vuelo a Madrid. El viajero mexicano se desplomó repentinamente, lo que llevó a los pasajeros que se encontraban en la zona a solicitar asistencia médica y provocó un ligero retraso en la salida del avión. El médico del equipo, el Doctor Diosdado Bolaños, se encontraban a apenas unos metros de distancia, lo que le llevó a acudir con celeridad al lugar para prestar ayuda al afectado. Tras atenderlo y conseguir estabilizar su estado, el hombre fue evacuado en ambulancia hasta un centro hospitalario para continuar con la atención médica. Su intervención fue recibida con aplausos por los pasajeros presentes en la zona de embarque. Aunque la acción rápida de Bolaños ha sido la gran anécdota, el viaje ya traía consigo otra. El club amarillo tuvo que dividir a la expedición hacia Bilbao en dos aviones diferentes ante la imposibilidad de conseguir plazas en un solo avión. Esto se debe a que LaLiga comunicó el 3 de septiembre las fechas y horarios de la séptima jornada. Con sólo 24 días para la disputa del partido, Las Palmas no tuvo apenas margen de maniobra.

articles.title: Manchester City charges: What punishment could club face after Premier League verdict and will they appeal?
articles.summary: It has taken more than two years, but a judgement finally appears to have been made on the 115 charges levelled against Manchester City. Here's what it means.
articles.body:
If you were getting the impression that the saga over Manchester City 's 115 charges was almost over, think again.

Two years and 10 days since the hearing began, and 1,329 days after City were charged, we now know a verdict has been reached, with the club guilty of the majority of financial rule breaches.

That is not because the Premier League or Manchester City have told us - it is thanks to the Athletic finding out and breaking the story. , external

BBC Sport was later told the verdict was sent during the week to club executives, who had to sign a non-disclosure agreement to open the file.

A process can appear to be completely watertight, as this one certainly had been, but when the circle of trust is expanded, the chance of information getting out increases.

Despite this, public silence from the Premier League continues.

City did not address whether they had been found guilty in a statement making it clear - with an appeal expected - that the "process remains ongoing" from their point of view.

It all points to the suggestion that the long-awaited decision of the independent panel was not a case of this process nearing an end, but perhaps instead reaching the end of the beginning.

It appears the chaos and uncertainty is only going to increase now.

City fans, and the rest of football, are left to guess what the punishment might be. And when this all might reach a definitive conclusion.

The charges are so serious that some form of points deduction now appears inevitable, subject to the appeal by City, who have always insisted they have done nothing wrong.

When and how any punishment is applied will be crucial not just for City, but the Premier League as a whole.

And that's before we get to the prospect of clubs suing City for compensation.

Enzo Maresca's side go to Liverpool on 11 October when the Premier League resumes after the international break. They could go six points clear at the top. But is that now rendered meaningless?

Let's look at possible scenarios - none of which are particularly appealing.

No Premier League appetite to strip Man City of titles - but threat remains

Scenario one: Nothing is announced this season on punishments

Deciding the punishment should be quicker than ascertaining guilt, but nothing is certain in this case.

As the charges have been denied, it will have to go to a sanction hearing convened by the independent panel.

BBC Sport has been told this hearing could still be months away, and the result may not be published until the appeal is completed.

At the hearing, everything will be on the table. Fines, points deductions and even demotion.

This differs from Chelsea 's case earlier this year, as the Stamford Bridge club self-reported and admitted guilt . That allowed them to negotiate with the Premier League and reach a sanctioning agreement.

It is possible that City could decide to hold their hands up and try to agree a deal - which would be better for the league - though that seems unlikely given the club's consistently strong denials over many years.

The panel will have to comb through the hundreds of pages of evidence and determine the punishment.

Remember, Everton were docked six points, reduced from 10 on appeal, and then two points in separate cases for breaches of profit and sustainability rules (PSR). Nottingham Forest were deducted four points.

These were considered to be minor breaches, while City faced seven separate charges on PSR breaches in the Premier League alone, as well as a further five related to Uefa competitions.

This aspect alone suggests a large points penalty.

That is before you get into the inflated sponsorship revenue allegedly channelled through the companies' accounts as a means of meeting financial fair play rules, payments to players and managers, and a failure to comply with investigations.

Take all this into account, and it places an asterisk against the Premier League between 2009 and 2018.

Chelsea and Manchester City , two of the competition's most successful clubs, have been part of that. While Chelsea admitted effectively cheating, City have been found guilty. They got around the financial rules to put them in a position to be able to sign more expensive players than their finances should have permitted.

And if this season passes with no decision on the sanction while it is known City were guilty of the majority of counts, what does that mean for the integrity of the competition?

Could a penalty be backdated to this season when finally awarded? Unlikely.

So what if Manchester City win the league?

Coventry are third from bottom right now. What if they finish in that position, are relegated, but would have stayed up had City's punishment come this season?

This inertia is terrible news for the Premier League as a competition.

There's a strong argument that a sanctioning agreement is the cleanest way out of this.

But that may not be palatable to the league as they would have to negotiate with City, who would presumably want a lesser punishment.

Clubs seek legal advice over Man City charges compensation

Man City fans face up to reality of guilty verdict

Man City legal fight could spiral out of control - Purslow

Scenario two: Man City punishment is levied this season but they appeal

The usual process when any points penalty is handed down is that it is applied immediately, subject to appeal.

It could be a points deduction so large that it is effectively a relegation.

Alternatively, if City's membership of the Premier League was revoked, it is unclear how that might be applied mid-season.

It could also be that the punishment is a huge fine, although that would seem unlikely given points deductions to other clubs.

The question would be how soon we hear, and how long after the appeal is heard.

Usually, the league asks for an expedited process from the independent arbitration company which handles disciplinary cases.

But, as ever in this case, the complexities indicate this is not straightforward.

There is the chance, though slim, that the punishment is only applied to the league table after the appeal.

That would surely lead to protests from impacted teams this season, who will demand it should, as usual, come into effect immediately.

Scenario three: Appeal is heard quickly and full decision announced

For the integrity of the Premier League, so all clubs know what they are playing for, this would need to happen sooner rather than later.

Last season, a points deduction for West Bromwich Albion related to breaches of profit and sustainability regulations was not announced until 24 April.

While ultimately they stayed in the Championship, it plunged them back into a relegation fight when they thought they were safe. It also gave some hope to the teams in the relegation zone.

The Premier League does not want this to drag on until the penultimate month of the season, but nothing is guaranteed in this story.

In this scenario, let's not forget City could also win their appeal, like they did over Uefa's punishment back in July 2020 .

While this would be celebrated at Etihad Stadium it would likely not be the end of the acrimony over the case.

Scenario four: Even after the case is closed, this is not over

Premier League clubs are seeking legal advice about compensation from Manchester City over the case.

One source, who held a senior executive position at two Premier League sides, said they expected clubs to submit individual compensation claims against Manchester City .

Another leading lawyer told the BBC that process could even be centralised by the league.

Premier League rules allow clubs to seek legal action against each other for compensation.

In June, Everton were told they must pay Burnley £35m after they broke PSR over a three-year period.

Burnley argued the breach impacted their chances of staying in the Premier League, and sought compensation for the losses associated with being relegated.

Everton are appealing, with sources previously saying they would "robustly and thoroughly" contest the ruling, but it provides an interesting backdrop to the Manchester City case.

There is uncertainty over a statute of limitations, which would set a cut-off point for claims.

Arsenal , Manchester United , Liverpool and Tottenham Hotspur reportedly preserved their rights to claim compensation two years ago.

This is not just about Manchester United (twice) and Liverpool , who finished as runners-up to City in their title-winning seasons.

It is about those clubs who just missed out on the Champions League, or failed to make Europe, or even those who were relegated.

And it could even result in claims over the prize money for each Premier League place, or the potential commercial earnings lost by rival clubs.

Kieran Maguire, professor of football finance at the University of Liverpool , told BBC Sport it would be considered a "denial of an opportunity" by complainants.

Maguire explained that the "statute of limitations is not referenced" in the Premier League's traditional handbook, though that could be subject to a legal challenge from City.

But what of the compensation? Just looking at Champions League qualifying could bring huge financial claims.

"The Champions League in those days was worth a minimum of £30m," Maguire said. "I think by the time we got to 2018, it was probably worth £60m or £70m, and that's in prize money.

"On top of that, you could claim for loss of gate receipts, loss of sponsor bonuses. This is highly unlikely, but it's certainly being discussed.

"Players get bonuses for qualifying for the Champions League. Those bonuses, if you talk to people connected to the elite clubs, are normally in the region of 25%.

"An average salary in those days would probably, if you go back to 2012, be in the region of £80,000 or £90,000 a week. Twenty-five percent of that is four or five million pounds a year. That's how the issues stack up."

Points deductions, fines, and compensation claims.

This is an extremely messy situation for the Premier League, and it does not look like being resolved anytime soon.

articles.summary: Los mejores números de su historia y 20,4 millones más que el ejercicio anterior
articles.body: El Athletic Club ha cerrado la temporada 2025/26 con los mejores ingresos de su historia sin contabilizar salidas de jugadores. El club ha alcanzado los 192,9 millones de euros, 20,4 millones más que el ejercicio anterior. Con ello, ha obtenido un beneficio neto de 20,6 millones. El EBITDA se ha situado en 38,1 millones, el doble que la campaña anterior. La participación en la Champions ha sido uno de los principales motores económicos. Los ingresos por competiciones han crecido un 19%, hasta situarse en los 59,7 millones, mientras que los derechos de retransmisión han aportado 81,9 millones. La publicidad y los patrocinios también han avanzado un 23%, hasta alcanzar los 12 millones. En conjunto, los ingresos deportivos se han situado en 153,6 millones. De cara a la nueva temporada, el Athletic ha presentado un presupuesto de 152,6 millones de euros, condicionado por la ausencia de competiciones europeas y el duodécimo puesto en LaLiga del pasado curso. Los ingresos por competiciones y retransmisiones van a caer en 50,7 millones y el club prevé 15,3 millones por traspasos y cesiones. Tras aplicar 17,1 millones en provisiones, el objetivo presupuestado es cerrar el ejercicio con resultado cero. El club mantiene una posición financiera sin endeudamiento y cifra su liquidez en 94 millones de euros, con un patrimonio neto de 112,8 millones. Las cuentas de la temporada 2025/26 y el presupuesto para 2026/27 serán revisados y sometidos a aprobación en la Asamblea General Ordinaria convocada para el próximo 28 de octubre.

articles.title: Desman Stephens Deactivates IG After Hit on Dante Moore, Riley Explains LB on USC Sideline After DQ
articles.summary: Desman Stephens II's targeting ejection for a brutal hit on Oregon quarterback Dante Moore overshadowed the Ducks' 41-27 victory over USC on Saturday, and the Trojans linebacker decided to deactivate his Instagram account in the aftermath.
articles.body:
Desman Stephens II's targeting ejection for a brutal hit on Oregon quarterback Dante Moore overshadowed the Ducks' 41-27 victory over USC on Saturday, and the Trojans linebacker decided to deactivate his Instagram account in the aftermath.

While he was ejected from the game after the hit that sent Moore off the field on a stretcher and caused an ensuing scuffle, he remained on the sideline for the contest.

USC head coach Lincoln Riley was asked why Stephens didn't go to the locker room after the ejection and said, "Because he's on our football team."

The hit occurred in the second quarter as Moore was attempting to slide on a scramble. Stephens launched himself, causing a collision that slammed the quarterback's head into the ground.

Moore remained down for some time until he was stretchered off.

"It was a disgusting play," Oregon head coach Dan Lanning told reporters . "The energy changed. A lot of guys on the sideline, they were emotional in that moment, including myself."

Lanning also provided an update on his team's quarterback and said, "He's in recovery, so I'm not going to speak too soon, but he is moving. He has the ability to move. So we continue to assess him."

Stephens' actions after his hit also added to the situation:

As for the game itself, Dylan Raiola entered in place of Moore and led the Ducks to a victory. The Nebraska transfer played brilliantly and finished 19-of-25 for 289 yards, two touchdowns and zero interceptions.

While protecting the ball and avoiding turnovers is often the most important job for a backup, Raiola did far more than that. He fired passes through tight windows, demonstrated immediate chemistry with tight end Jamari Johnson (seven catches for 119 yards) and was the best player on the field for extended stretches.

As a result, the Ducks picked up an important Big Ten win that will resonate when the College Football Playoff committee is putting together its 12-team field.

Oregon now enters a bye week before an Oct. 10 showdown with undefeated UCLA. USC will host Washington before back-to-back road games against Penn State and Wisconsin.

articles.title: Tartan Army give Sebastien Pocognoli cautious welcome after first Scotland game
articles.summary: Scotland fans appear to have mainly emerged positive from Sebastien Pocognoli's debut as head coach.
articles.body:
Sebastien Pocognoli, his players and much of the media saw enough in Saturday's Nations League opener in Slovenia to remain positive after the new head coach's debut in charge despite the goalless draw.

On BBC Radio Scotland's Sportsound, former internationals Callum Davidson, Willie Miller and Michael Stewart voiced some words of caution, reserving judgement on the Belgian's system as he prepares for Switzerland's visit on Tuesday.

But what of the Tartan Army? We asked for your views and here is a selection.

Why does Robbie Ure have Robbie Ure on his Scotland shirt?

Swiss hail 'great job' without Xhaka & Embolo

From turgid to thrusting - mixed start for new Scotland

It is fair to say a slight majority of respondents were enthused by what they saw at Ljubljana's Stadion Stozice, mainly by the second-half display...

Craig: First Scotland game in years where I haven't had palpitations. I loved the energy in second half. We may not have scored but the new formation and attacking focus was excellent. Let's build from here.

George: First half, bit worrying. Second half, different class. Positive. Quality. Solid in defence (keeper could've been sat on a deckchair). Finishing needs a wee polish but there are positive signs there too. Fingers crossed after a positive start under the new boss.

Rosh: It was practically two different performances in one game. First half, we were very poor and struggled to string two passes together. However, the second half was like a totally different Scotland team. Slovenia could barely get out of their own half. Overall pleased with the performance in the second half but taking our opportunities continues to be our Achilles heel.

Derek: Don't want to disparage Steve Clarke but would rather lose playing like that than what Stevie was serving up. Football with the fear of losing is not what the fans like. But, having said that, I have to admit it was great getting to the World Cup.

Stuart: This Scotland team has to be built around [Billy] Gilmour and [Lewis] Ferguson. [Robbie] Ure looks good and deserves a run of matches to prove it. Back three a bit shaky but a new system of positive play will take time to adapt to. Overall, a positive display.

Archie: Disappointing not to get off the mark with a win. But sufficiently positive for our first game after five days with our new manager.

Lindsey: Feeling positive. I think we're moving in the right direction. Gilmour was outstanding and I think he inspired others around him. After a nervy (same old) start, the team began to build some self-belief and hopefully that can be continued at Hampden on Tuesday night.

Shuggie: Massive difference between the halves. We seemed half asleep, dithering through the first half but all over them like a rash in the second. Promising but really disappointing not to win. Gilmour was superb.

Mark: Poor first half but this is a team starting to adapt to a new manager and system. Second half was far better, so encouraged about how things will progress. Given time, I think this manager will get things right.

Simon: A lot to like in that second half. Chances made - taking them is the challenge and that isn't a new problem. Midfield used the ball well in possession and were competitive on winning the ball back.

Colin: Nice to see the new manager changing things around as the squad needed freshening up. Our defence has lacked pace and relied on too many players out of form. Picking players that are actually playing weekly will help. New attacking options were needed, so hopefully these new players will step up. Let's give them and the manager a chance.

Mark: Signs are positive but we still lack the clear and present danger of a striker who can finish at the first attempt. Not sure any of the new starts will be the answer to our lack of goals.

'Same old' with 'struggle' to score goals

There are, though, a few dissenting voices who fear Scotland's old failings remain...

Thomas: Similar issues to the Clarke era - our finishing let us down. Slovenia were there for the taking and we couldn't get it over the line.

Brian: Another poor performance. New guys in who did reasonable, older heads not all did reasonable. Big worry for Tuesday night. Hopefully we can improve.

Jim: Different manager, same style of play and tactics, disappointing overall. Against a very poor Slovenian side, we struggled to make any clear scoring opportunities. If [Ben] Gannon-Doak had played down the right and [Josh] McPake down the left from the start, I think we would have won comfortably. I will look for a significant improvement over the four matches and see if there is any grounds for optimism or are we set for another few years of occasional good results.

Alexander: Very slow start. [Scott] McKenna better left on bench as his confidence is low at present. [Stephen] Welsh improved as game progressed but he still struggled at times. Ure unfortunate, with [Oli] McBurnie trying his hardest. Encouraging signs but more urgency required in getting the ball forward to the strikers. Gannon-Doak provided energy when he came on.

Allan: Still feel players are too negative and slow moving the ball. More ambition moving forward was the way goals were scored by the great players.

Gordon: Same old, same old. Dreadful first half followed by a much better second half. But we don't have a striker worth the name. [Che] Adams and [Lyndon] Dykes are done but bringing back a tried and failed striker in McBurnie is never going to be the answer. [Kieron] Bowie might be, in time, but he missed a sitter. And Gannon-Doak needs to be on from the start.

David: Not even close to being good enough.

articles.title: Ireland name defender as goalkeeper in bizarre move ahead of reluctant Nations League clash with Israel
articles.summary: In a surprising move, Ireland has named defender Jimmy Dunne as a goalkeeper for their upcoming Nations League match against Israel after Gavin Bazunu withdrew due to personal beliefs. This decision follows intense discussions among the team regarding the match amid political tensions.
articles.body: Ireland have found themselves in a remarkably unusual situation ahead of their Nations League meeting with Israel, with QPR defender Jimmy Dunne being listed as a goalkeeper after Gavin Bazunu withdrew from the squad.Bazunu's decision came after a day of lengthy discussions within the Ireland camp over whether the fixture should go ahead at all. The team eventually voted by a “significant majority” to play, but Bazunu decided he could not take part, saying his personal beliefs meant he felt it would be wrong to participate in the matches against Israel.That left Ireland needing another goalkeeper on the squad list, and Dunne, who normally plays at centre-back for QPR, was the rather unexpected solution. UEFA's squad listing now includes him alongside Caoimhín Kelleher and Max O'LearyBazunu pulls out after players spend hours discussing the fixtureThe Ireland camp had already been under considerable pressure in the build-up to the match, with calls in Ireland for the team to boycott the two Nations League fixtures against Israel.The first meeting is being played in Debrecen, Hungary, with Ireland's other fixture against Israel scheduled for October 4 in Bačka Topola, Serbia. The controversy surrounding the games has been linked to Israel's military actions in Gaza and the wider political debate around whether Israel should be taking part in international football.Things became particularly tense on Saturday when Ireland's scheduled training session and press conference were delayed by more than five hours while the players discussed whether they should fulfil the fixture.FAI chief executive David Courell said one player had told manager Heimir Hallgrímsson that they were uncomfortable taking part and intended to withdraw from the squad.“What proceeded was another four hours of conversations, predominantly amongst the players themselves, but also at times with the coaching staff and the executive,” Courell said.“Ultimately we carried out a vote amongst the squad ... and it was a significant majority that was returned with the intention to continue.”The player was later confirmed as Bazunu, who explained his decision in a statement posted on Instagram.“Representing my country means everything to me. I have the utmost respect for every single one of my teammates, the manager, his staff, and the Irish people,” Bazunu said.“However, I have reached a decision that I have not taken lightly. I am a man of strong faith, and try my best to be a person of character and principle, therefore I feel it would be wrong to participate in the upcoming fixtures against Israel.”Bazunu said his decision was based on his personal belief that killing innocent people was wrong, while making clear that he did not intend his position to be directed at Israeli people or the Jewish community.“My decision is based purely on my personal belief that the killing of innocent people is wrong,” he said.“It is important to note that my stance is not in opposition of the Israeli people or the Jewish community, but against the atrocities in the region.”He added: “There are a few times where you get a chance in life to stand up for something bigger, and I strongly believe that this is one of them.”So Ireland turned a defender into a goalkeeperBazunu's withdrawal left Ireland needing to make a change to their squad, with UEFA regulations requiring three goalkeepers to be listed.The QPR defender is normally used at centre-back and has no regular role as a goalkeeper, but he has now been listed as Ireland's third goalkeeper for the match. UEFA's official squad list places Dunne at No.23 alongside Kelleher and O'Leary.It is an unusual sight for an international squad, but it gives Ireland the third goalkeeper required for the fixture after Bazunu's departure.Courell also confirmed that the players who remain with the squad had agreed to make several changes to the usual matchday routine as a way of showing their unease with the situation.Ireland intend to wear black armbands “in recognition of all the lives lost in the conflict”, while players will also refrain from parts of the normal pre-match ceremony, including the handshake and exchange of pennants.The squad have also decided to effectively remove their media obligations for the remainder of the international window, according to Courell.The FAI said there would also be significant charitable contributions connected to match fees and revenue from the Austria fixture.The match will go ahead despite the pressure around itFor all the uncertainty surrounding the fixture, Ireland's players ultimately decided that the match should be played.The vote followed several hours of discussion, with Courell saying a “significant majority” of the squad wanted to continue with the games. Hallgrímsson also confirmed that the fixture would go ahead, despite the withdrawal of one player.That means Ireland will face Israel in Debrecen, with Dunne now listed as one of the three goalkeepers and Bazunu watching from outside the squad.The second meeting between the teams will take place in Bačka Topola, Serbia, on October 4, with that fixture scheduled to be played behind closed doors. articles.title: El vestuario del Atlético no olvida el derbi: “No están acostumbrados a que se lo hagan a ellos”
articles.standfirst: Las palabras de Baena recuerdan el sentir de los rojiblancos respecto a las quejas del Madrid: “Es una rabieta, de no saber perder”
articles.summary: Las palabras de Baena recuerdan el sentir de los rojiblancos respecto a las quejas del Madrid: “Es una rabieta, de no saber perder”
articles.body: Habló Baena horas antes del choque en Wembley en el que el jugador del Atlético salió desde el banquillo para marcar el 2-2 y dar el 2-3. El 10 rojiblanco fue preguntado en Telemadrid por el derbi de hace una semana contra el Madrid y no tuvo dudas sobre los motivos de todo lo que pasó una vez el colegiado Ortiz Arias pitó el final en el Metropolitano. "Creo que se queja porque ha perdido, si hubiese pasado al revés no se hablaría tanto de estas polémicas de los árbitros. Es lo que siempre suele pasar, que cuando el Madrid pierde contra el Atlético pues intenta buscar otras cosas y no centrarse en ello", comentó antes de considerar una rabieta la rueda de prensa de Mou: "A mí sí que me lo puede parecer, porque creo que el show que se dio en rueda de prensa con los papelitos sí que me parece de rabieta y de no saber perder", zanjó explicando el sentir del vestuario rojiblanco. Las palabras de Baena, en ese sentido, reflejan lo que se ha vivido en los días posteriores al derbi en clave rojiblanca. Saben y entienden que el arbitraje de Ortiz Arias es susceptible de crítica en algún pasaje del partido, pero creen que hay un trecho incomprensible en basar todo el análisis del choque obviando la superioridad del Atlético con 10, especialmente, pero también con 11. También se sorprenden en la caseta del Atlético sobre la furibunda crítica del Madrid, equipo contra el que muchas veces se han sentido perjudicados en duelos recientes y no tan recientes. Cuentan por varios los choques de la máxima rivalidad madrileña (expulsión de Ceballos, de Correa, etc...) en los que el equipo del Metropolitano considera que el arbitraje cayó del lado blanco y, teniendo en cuenta estos precedentes, les sorprende todavía más el nivel de ruido provocado por el último derbi. De ahí que la reflexión profunda, en hilo con las palabras del propio Baena, vaya por ahí: "No están acostumbrados a que se lo hagan a ellos. Están sintiendo lo que sienten siempre muchos equipos cuando van al Bernabéu ", comentan en clave rojiblanca mientras recuerdan arbitrajes del pasado reciente -por citar dos- como los que sufrieron Almería y Celta, quizá los dos más sonados por la cantidad de errores a favor del conjunto de Chamartín. Sea como fuere, en el Atlético -que ya respondió en redes y en un confidencial en MARCA sobre las quejas de Mourinho- esperan que todo lo acontecido durante la última semana no embarre los derbis de lo que queda de temporada. Entienden que el 2-1 del pasado domingo fue justo porque el Atlético fue mejor. Queda el del Bernabéu de LaLiga, pero bien podrían encontrarse en la Copa del Rey, en la Champions o en la Supercopa de España, donde si ganan a Real Sociedad y Barça serían los protagonistas de la gran final.

articles.title: Blasi mira al Europeo tras su abandono en el Mundial: "Quiero recuperarme rápido"
articles.standfirst: La ciclista española sufrió una caída a 94 kilómetros de meta en la prueba en ruta de Montreal. Pudo continuar unos minutos, pero terminó bajándose de la bicicleta.
articles.summary: La ciclista española sufrió una caída a 94 kilómetros de meta en la prueba en ruta de Montreal. Pudo continuar unos minutos, pero terminó bajándose de la bicicleta.
articles.body: El Mundial de Paula Blasi acabó antes de tiempo. La catalana quedó atrapada en una caída múltiple a 94 kilómetros de la meta y, aunque logró reanudar la marcha, las consecuencias del golpe la obligaron a abandonar poco después. Ya fuera de carrera, Blasi compartió una imagen en la que se apreciaban heridas junto al ojo derecho y explicó que, a su regreso, se someterá a pruebas en las costillas "para asegurarme de que todo está bien". Por ahora no ha comunicado el resultado de ninguna exploración. "Esta estuvo muy lejos de ser la carrera que esperábamos", reconoció en Instagram. La española agradeció el apoyo de sus compañeras y contó que no se encontraba al cien por cien antes de la caída, aunque el equipo había mantenido su plan para la carrera. Blasi confía en recuperarse a tiempo para disputar el Campeonato de Europa y las últimas citas de la temporada. "Aún queda guerra por dar", escribió para tranquilizar a quienes se interesaron por su estado.

articles.title: El Almería asalta Son Moix y se lleva el duelo de candidatos
articles.standfirst: Un gol de Miguel de la Fuente tras un error grosero de Arnau Tenas, primero que recibe el Mallorca en casa, decide el partido
articles.summary: Un gol de Miguel de la Fuente tras un error grosero de Arnau Tenas, primero que recibe el Mallorca en casa, decide el partido
articles.body: Un gol de Miguel de la Fuente, que cuajó un partidazo y supo aprovechar un error grosero de Arnau Tenas, le valió al Almería para doblegar al Mallorca en el primero duelo de la temporada entre candidatos al ascenso. De este modo, los bermellones dejan escapar sus primeros puntos de Son Moix y los indálicos suman su cuarta victoria consecutiva. Comenzaba el partido con un Mallorca intenso, dueño de la posesión y volcado sobre el área de un Almería que apenas lograba entrar en juego. Luis García había apostado por un 4-3-3 con varias novedades: Darder se quedaba en el banquillo, John Chetauya sustituía a Valjent, concentrado con Eslovaquia, y Antoniu Roca volvía al once como extremo derecho tras varias suplencias. Los bermellones acumulaban acercamientos, aunque sin generar excesivo peligro. La primera ocasión clara llegó en el minuto 20, cuando Adri Fuentes sirvió un gran balón a Roca, que definió demasiado centrado y se encontró con Andrés Fernández, mientras un cabezazo del primero se salió rozando el larguero. Diez minutos después, el extremo se lesionó del isquiotibial izquierdo en una presión tras pérdida y Josep Cerdà entró en su lugar. A la media hora fue Pablo Torre el que rondó el 1-0, pero su disparo cruzado se estrelló en el poste. Sin embargo el que golpeó de verdad fue el Almería. Un error grosero de Arnau Tenas, que rechazó mal un potente disparo en una falta lejana de Embarba, dejó el balón a merced de Miguel de la Fuente. El delantero marcó ante la pasividad de la defensa mallorquinista. Un premio excesivo para un equipo visitante que había mostrado muy poco fútbol. El Mallorca reaccionó poco después con una falta al borde del área lanzada por Pablo Torre, pero Andrés Fernández volvió a aparecer con una buena mano para evitar el empate. La primera parte terminó con otro contratiempo para lo bermellones, ya que Manu Morlanes se dañó el tobillo en una acción en la que cometió falta sobre un rival. En el segundo tiempo un Mallorca muy estático no conseguía desarbolar al Almería, que incluso disfrutó de las mejores ocasiones, sobre todo una clarísima de Sergio Arribas tras un gran giro en la frontal a pase de Miguel y un disparo con rosca ajustado al poste. Los de Luis García tuvieron que ir a por el partido, al menos en el plano táctico, y dejaron muchos espacios que los de García Pimienta aprovecharon para sumar ocasiones de peligro. En la recta final, los locales se fueron a por todo y generaron ocasiones, como la que tuvo Darder en la recta final tras un centro desde la derecha, pero no logró superar a Andrés. Precisamente desde ese lado también gozaron de otras claras John Chetauya, cuyo cabezazo lo sacó con una soberbia parada Andrés cuando el balón ya entraba en su puerta, y Adri Fuentes, pero el Mallorca no pudo perforar la portería de un acertadísimo portero visitante. Incluso el capitán Raíllo recibió una roja directa por una entrada sobre Miguel, pero la corrigió Daniel Palencia a instancias del VAR. Así las cosas, el primer duelo entre contendientes al ascenso directo en Son Moix cae para el lado indálico, que además anota el primer gol de un conjunto visitante en el feudo bermellón.

articles.title: WSL: Man Utd earn first league win of season as Liverpool beat rivals Everton while Tottenham thrash Aston Villa
articles.summary: Manchester United earn their first WSL win of the season after a 2-1 home win over West Ham; Liverpool beat rivals Everton 2-0 at Anfield; Tottenham score four second-half goals to thrash Aston Villa; Birmingham hit late equaliser to snatch 3-3 draw against Crystal Palace
articles.body:
Man Utd beat West Ham 2-1 at Leigh Sports Village to collect their first WSL win of the season.

Eva Olid's side - who picked up just one point from their first three league games of 2026/27 - took the lead inside 10 minutes, when Elisabeth Terland headed in Anna Sandberg's header unchallenged.

They might have been 2-0 up had it not been for Hammers goalkeeper Constance Picaud, who brilliantly tipped Hanna Lundkvist's header over the bar in the last action of the first half.

United came out with the bit between their teeth and had three chances in three minutes: Andrea Medina hit the bar, Jess Park shot wide and Terland forced another fingertip save from Picaud.

It took an hour for West Ham's first shot on target, which came when Estelle Cascarino ran through the middle untracked and hit a dipping drive, which Phallon Tullis-Joyce had to be alert to tip over.

With 18 minutes of the 90 to play, the excellent Medina did make it 2-0 when she collected a peach of a pass from Park and found the postage stamp after her initial shot was blocked.

But Viviane Asseyi prevented United from keeping a clean sheet when she rolled a penalty into the bottom left corner after she was tripped by Sandberg. Dan Long

Chelsea extended their unbeaten run in the WSL to 12 games and moved up to third in the table with a 1-0 London derby win over Arsenal at Stamford Bridge.

The streak - comprising 10 wins and two draws - stretches back to February 8 and ended the Gunners' own unbeaten record, which spanned 23 games and just under 12 months.

Arsenal were the dominant force for much of the first half and Kim Little, then Mariona Caldentey, were both denied by the woodwork, but they ended the half without a single shot on target.

And they fell behind when Keira Walsh's shot from 20 yards was saved by Anneke Borbe, with the rebound fired high into the net by Alyssa Thompson.

Renee Slegers brought on Chloe Kelly, Caitlin Foord and Stina Blackstenius to freshen things up going forward for the visitors, but to no avail.

As a result, her side have failed to win for the third league game in succession, meaning they trail leaders Man City by seven points. Dan Long

Liverpool secured a 2-0 win against Everton to hand the club their first WSL Merseyside derby victory at Anfield.

Liverpool had previously lost eight of their nine WSL games played at Anfield, with five of those losses coming against Everton.

However, a looping header from Beata Olsson gave Gareth Taylor's side the perfect start in just the fourth minute.

The Reds threatened throughout but were denied a second on two occasions due to the stoic defensive performance of Ruby Mace in midfield, blocking Natalia Ramos' goal-bound shot and clearing Cornelia Kapocs' effort off the line.

Kapocs would not be denied on the second time of asking, however, as she swept home the second to seal the win with just under five minutes to go. Patrick Rowe

Tottenham surged to a 4-0 win against Aston Villa following a dominant second-half performance to keep within touching distance of Manchester City at the top of the table.

The victory moves Spurs within two points of the league leaders with 10 points from their opening four games.

Villa, who sit in 13th, kept their opponents at bay before the break but the floodgates would open following Victoria Pelova's opener in the 54th minute.

The 27-year-old doubled the lead with a curling effort soon after before Caitlin Dijkstra's back post header and Cathinka Tandberg on the rebound put the game out of reach.

Newly-promoted Birmingham are still searching for their first WSL win after rescuing a point in a six-goal thriller against Crystal Palace at St Andrew's.

Suzu Amano came off the bench for the Blues to hit a deflected 87th-minute equaliser to salvage a point in a 3-3 draw.

Birmingham had looked on course for a first win of the season as they led 2-1 at half-time thanks to Oceane Hurtre's double.

The forward hit an opener after just 40 seconds, but Palace equalised in the 30th minute after a goalkeeper howler allowed Shanade Hopcroft's free-kick to go in.

But just three minutes later, Hurtre restored Birmingham's lead with a powerful strike from a tight angle.

Palace, however, mounted a second-half comeback as Bethany England rebounded in a 70th-minute equaliser before Lexi Lloyd-Smith completed the turnaround with a fine one-on-one finish.

But the home side battled back in a topsy-turvy encounter as Amano struck to pick up Birmingham's second point of the campaign and deny Palace their second win of the league season.

articles.title: Araujo vuelve a disfrutar
articles.standfirst: Encadena ya cinco titularidades y se consolida en el lateral derecho
articles.summary: Encadena ya cinco titularidades y se consolida en el lateral derecho
articles.body: Araujo está viviendo un momento muy dulce en el Liverpool. El defensa uruguayo ha recuperado el protagonismo y los minutos que no tenía en el Barcelona y, en apenas unas semanas, se ha convertido en una pieza importante para el conjunto inglés. El internacional charrúa decidió salir el pasado verano en calidad de cedido rumbo a la Premier League y sus primeros registros con el bloque inglés están siendo muy positivos. Además, en los tres últimos encuentros del campeonato regular, en los que el Liverpool ha conseguido mantener la portería a cero, Araujo ha actuado como lateral derecho. Una posición que no le resulta desconocida y en la que está demostrando que puede ofrecer un buen rendimiento, especialmente en partidos en los que el equipo necesita solidez defensiva y capacidad para contener el juego por banda. El Liverpool ha disputado siete encuentros en lo que va de temporada y Araujo ha sido titular en cinco de ellos. En los dos primeros compromisos del curso tuvo minutos, aunque partió desde el banquillo. Su situación cambió a partir del encuentro contra el Ipswich Town. Fue titular en ese partido y, desde entonces, se ha ganado un puesto en el once inicial. Precisamente contra el Ipswich ya actuó como lateral derecho, una demarcación en la que ha encontrado continuidad en las últimas jornadas. También ocupó esa posición en el estreno del Liverpool en la Champions League contra el Atlético de Madrid. En ese encuentro, además de completar una actuación destacada, dejó su sello con una asistencia de tacón para Szoboszlai y fue elegido MVP del cruce. Su protagonismo continuó contra el Fulham, también como lateral derecho. En ese encuentro disputó 72 minutos antes de ser sustituido. Posteriormente, en la EFL Cup, el 15 de septiembre, el Liverpool se enfrentó al Tottenham con Araujo de nuevo en el once inicial. El uruguayo completó los 90 minutos y volvió a demostrar que se encuentra cada vez más asentado en Inglaterra. En el último encuentro antes del parón, contra el Bournemouth, el internacional volvió a ocupar el lateral derecho. De esta manera, Araujo ha ido acumulando minutos y confianza en una posición que conoce bien y en la que ya había tenido protagonismo durante su etapa en el Barcelona. El carril derecho de la defensa no es una novedad para Araujo. En el conjunto azulgrana ya tuvo que desempeñarse en esa demarcación en diferentes ocasiones, especialmente en los enfrentamientos contra el Real Madrid. En algunos Clásicos, el cuerpo técnico recurrió a su velocidad y fortaleza física para intentar frenar a Vinicius. En la última temporada en el Barcelona, sin embargo, Araujo pasó a tener un papel más secundario. La banda derecha estaba ocupada principalmente por Koundé, mientras que en el centro de la defensa la competencia también era elevada. Con el paso de los meses, otras alternativas fueron ganando peso en el eje de la zaga. Su llegada al Liverpool le ha permitido cambiar su escenario. En Inglaterra ha encontrado los minutos y la confianza que necesitaba. Su capacidad para desenvolverse tanto como central como en el lateral derecho le ofrece, además, una versatilidad que es clave. El conjunto de la Premier League se hace cargo de la ficha del zaguero durante su cesión y, además, se aseguró una opción de compra de 55 millones de euros. Mientras tanto, Araujo está aprovechando su oportunidad sobre el terreno de juego. Su adaptación ha sido rápida y está recuperando un protagonismo que había perdido en el Spotify Camp Nou. El uruguayo vuelve a sonreír con la camiseta del Liverpool. Su continuidad en el once y su buen rendimiento han convertido sus primeras semanas en Inglaterra en una experiencia positiva. Ahora, el reto pasa por mantener esa regularidad y confirmar que puede ser una pieza importante para el conjunto inglés.

articles.title: LSU Trolls Marcel Reed, Texas A&M with Celebration Video After Lane Kiffin, Tigers' Blowout Win
articles.summary: To the victors go the spoils, which means LSU got to do some trolling of Texas A&M and quarterback Marcel Reed after Saturday's 35-6 blowout win.
articles.body:
To the victors go the spoils, which means LSU got to do some trolling of Texas A&M and quarterback Marcel Reed after Saturday's 35-6 blowout win.

LSU posted a highlight montage of its defenders making plays against Reed with the caption, "Death Valley wasn't so underwhelming this time around."

It was a reference to a comment Reed made during an appearance on The Triple Option podcast (h/t Braden Ramsey of Saturday Down South) ahead of the 2025 matchup between the two teams in which he referenced a 2023 game that had a noon ET kickoff.

"[That] wasn't a night game… so [it was] a little underwhelming," he said at the time. "I'm just really excited to see what the atmosphere is like. You know, I've heard a lot of things. I've heard the fans are crazy. They do all types of stuff."

It was a raucous environment Saturday night, as Lane Kiffin's team bounced back from a loss to Ole Miss in dramatic fashion. The defense held Reed to 10-of-26 passing for 106 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception.

His previous comments clearly hadn't been forgotten either given the post on social media.

articles.title: Dylan Raiola Drops Epic Quote After Replacing Injured Dante Moore in Oregon Win vs. USC
articles.summary: Oregon quarterback Dylan Raiola said he was playing in honor of injured starter Dante Moore while closing out Oregon's Saturday win over USC.
articles.body:
Oregon quarterback Dylan Raiola said he was playing in honor of injured starter Dante Moore while closing out Oregon's Saturday win over USC.

After Moore was taken away by an ambulance following a hit to the head in the second quarter, Raiola passed for 289 yards and two touchdowns to help No. 20 Oregon claim a 41-27 win over NO. 12 USC.

"The wolf came out, and we made sure that our prey felt what we were preparing for all week," Raiola said after the game.

Raiola continued, "The game of football doesn't feel sorry for us. We've got to step up, and we've got to keep fighting, and those guys in that locker room did just that. Coming on the road and doing what we did is not normal."

Raiola saw his first action since transferring from Nebraska to Oregon in a blowout of Portland State the week prior, during which he went 11-for-11 with 124 yards and three touchdowns in relief of Moore.

The former Cornhuskers starter went 19-for-25 in his second appearance of the season while helping the Ducks score touchdowns on four of five second-half drives against USC.

His performance helped keep Oregon's playoff hopes alive following an upset loss at Oklahoma State in Week 2.

How much playing time Raiola sees going forward could hinge on the health of Moore, who is ranked as the No. 2 quarterback in the 2027 NFL draft class on the latest B/R big board .

CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz and Chris Hummer reported Sunday Moore is believed to have suffered a concussion but no additional injuries. According to Zenitz and Hummer, the quarterback "is expected back at some point."

Oregon coach Dan Lanning could turn back to Raiola in the short term as the Ducks prepare for next Saturday's matchup against visiting UCLA while potentially missing their star quarterback.

articles.body:
Última hora del Noruega - Portugal en directo:

La UEFA Nations League avanza y Noruega y Portugal vuelven a verse las caras diez años después. Ambas selecciones arrancaron la competición con victoria y afrontan el segundo encuentro con la mirada puesta en los cuartos de final. Los lusos, además, quieren volver a levantar el título que ya conquistaron en dos ocasiones, mientras que Noruega busca seguir dando pasos entre la élite internacional.

Los nórdicos llegan después de imponerse a Dinamarca (3-2) , con un Haaland decisivo gracias a su doblete . Debutantes en la Liga A, quieren demostrar que ya tienen sitio entre las grandes selecciones. Después de su gran papel ante Brasil en el Mundial, ahora tendrán otra prueba de altura ante una Portugal que también comenzó con buen pie.

Portugal, por su parte, superó por la mínima a Gales (1-0) en su regreso tras la eliminación mundialista ante España. Con Jorge Jesus al frente, sustituto de Roberto Martínez, y Cristiano Ronaldo como gran referente ofensivo, los portugueses buscan seguir con las buenas sensaciones y dar otro paso hacia los cuartos de final. El delantero, además, continúa persiguiendo la histórica cifra de los 1.000 goles .

Pero el gran atractivo del encuentro estará en el duelo que el fútbol llevaba años esperando: Cristiano Ronaldo contra Erling Haaland . Será la primera vez que ambos compartan terreno de juego. En el derbi de Manchester de 2022, el portugués no participó y el noruego fue protagonista con un 'hat-trick'. Ahora sí, las dos generaciones del gol se encuentran frente a frente. Casi nada.

No queda nada para que eche a rodar el balón en el Ullevaal Stadium de Oslo .

articles.title: La Dinamarca de Hjulmand se desquita
articles.standfirst: Los goles de Davies, propia, e Isaksen en la segunda parte valieron el triunfo frente a Gales (2-0)
articles.summary: Los goles de Davies, propia, e Isaksen en la segunda parte valieron el triunfo frente a Gales (2-0)
articles.body: La eliminación de Dinamarca en la 'repesca' del Mundial supuso una profunda decepción. Pero, tras arrancar la Nations League con derrota frente a Noruega, se desquitaron imponiéndose a Gales (2-0). Con Hjulmand —completó el partido entero— a los mandos, formando doble pivote junto a Hojbjerg, parecía que la suerte no estaba del lado de Dinamarca. A los 24', el VAR entró para anular un gol de Isaksen y, sólo tres minutos después, Damsgaard se topó con la madera. Por si fuera poco, Dorgu tuvo que abandonar el campo a la media hora de partido por unos problemas físicos. El panorama cambió por completo, sin embargo, en los compases iniciales de la segunda parte gracias a dos balones parados servidos por Damsgaard desde el sector derecho. El primero, en el 53', acabó en gol en propia de Ben Davies... y el 2-0 lo firmó Isaksen de rechace conectando una volea 'mordida'. Tuvo, eso sí, que ser ratificado por el VAR. Daramy, que había entrado en sustitución de Dorgu en la primera, perdonó la sentencia a puerta vacía en la recta final. A Hojlund, además, también le anularon un gol a falta de cinco minutos para el final. No lo tuvo que lamentar Dinamarca y terminó sacando sus tres primeros puntos en esta Nations League.

articles.title: Xavi ya gana con Países Bajos: doblete de Meerdink para derribar a Serbia
articles.standfirst: El delantero del AZ contrarrestó el tanto serbio del exmadridista Luka Jovic
articles.summary: El delantero del AZ contrarrestó el tanto serbio del exmadridista Luka Jovic
articles.body: Dos goles del joven Meerdink (23 años) fueron suficientes para el primer triunfo de Xavi Hernández al frente de Países Bajos (1-2). Fue en el viejo Pequeño Maracaná ante Serbia. Los neerlandeses venían de un buen debut ante Alemania en juego, aunque no tanto en resultado (1-1), conseguido por Holanda (léase Países Bajos) a última hora. La victoria de hoy es obra de Mexx Meerdink, que debutó en esta Holanda ante Alemania el jueves pasado y hoy debutaba en un once tras la lesión de Brobbey. El delantero de Alkmaar es hijo de Martijn, internacional absoluto a principios de siglo, y Mexx ya empezó a sonar al ser héroe (dos goles y asistencia en la final) del AZ campeón de la Youth League 22-23, por delante de jóvenes figuras de entonces Lamine Yamal (Barça) o Nico Paz (Real Madrid). Países Bajos quería solventar pronto el partido, con un once parecido al del jueves, y la inclusión del citado Meerdink en lugar del lesionado Brobbey. Y fue él quien puso el 0-1 en el minuto 28' tras un penalti cometido sobre Summerville. La primera parte terminó con dominio visitante (65% de posesión). Y eso que no empezó bien con la lesión de Gakpo, sustituido por el joven Ruben Van Bommel. En el descanso, el seleccionador serbio Paunovic hizo cambios y el exmadridista Luka Jovic, ahora en el AEK Atenas, entró en la punta de ataque. Pues bien, en el primer minuto, el ariete ya había puesto el 1-1 en un barullo en el área, mal interpretado por el madridista Dumfries, que quedó enganchado, y la jugada fue resuelta por Jovic. Desde entonces, los de Xavi recuperaron el dominio. Dos ocasiones de Van Bommel (al palo) y Reijnders (alto) precedieron al 1-2 de Meerdink, el gran héroe tulipán para los primeros tres puntos de XH. Serbia lo intentó, y Jovic estuvo a punto de poner el 2-2 en un cabezazo que se fue por poco. Pero Xavi metió a los dos hermanos Timber para intentar tener control del partido y mantuvo la distancia hasta el final (1-2).

articles.title: Una crisis interminable
articles.standfirst: Las bajas vuelven a golpear al Madrid, que suma las mismas lesiones que la temporada pasada a estas alturas. Seis jugadores están en la enfermería
articles.summary: Las bajas vuelven a golpear al Madrid, que suma las mismas lesiones que la temporada pasada a estas alturas. Seis jugadores están en la enfermería
articles.body: Reducir las lesiones era uno de los objetivos del Real Madrid para volver a ser competitivos. Los problemas físicos fueron un motivo de tensión en el club, molesto con las 60 lesiones que acumuló el equipo la pasada temporada. Un año en el que sólo Vinicius, Gonzalo, Brahim y Fran García no se lesionaron. El resto cayeron en mayor o menor medida. Una campaña que fue un goteo constante de bajas, con cuatro meses en los que hubo siete lesionados y un terrorífico mes de noviembre en el que el listón llegó a las 11. Pero la crisis parece no tener fin. El parón está siendo negativo y ahora mismo Mourinho tiene seis jugadores en la enfermería: Rodrygo, Militao, Mendy, Mbappé, Valverde y Konaté. En total, nueve lesiones acumula el Madrid en lo que va de temporada, las mismas que el año pasado a estas alturas. Una crisis interminable. Porque hay que recordar que Mou ya tuvo que afrontar los cinco primeros partidos con siete ausencias en cada uno de ellos. El Madrid regresa este lunes al trabajo en Valdebebas (10.30) tras una semana de vacaciones y lo hace con un panorama desolador hasta que los internacionales regresen. Mourinho tendrá los próximos días a seis jugadores del primer equipo a su disposición: Courtois, Lunin, Carreras, Rüdiger, Asencio y Tchouaméni. Ni un solo delantero en la corta nómina de jugadores. El resto, seis jugadores lesionados y 14 con sus respectivas selecciones, con Thiago Pitarch entre ellos tras incorporarse a la selección sub 20 después de jugar ayer con el Real Madrid Castilla. Un parón por tanto al que poco le puede sacar Mourinho a la hora de mejorar o trabajar ciertos aspectos en la mejora de las prestaciones del equipo. El técnico se limitará a activar a los jugadores que tiene disponibles y rodearlos de canteranos para completar los próximos entrenamientos. Eso y cruzar los dedos para que el ‘virus FIFA’ no golpee más a sus futbolistas, después de un comienzo de parón marcado por las lesiones de Konaté y, sobre todo, de Mbappé. Todo ello tras la lesión de Valverde en el derbi previo a los compromisos de selecciones. Cierto es que los tres últimos problemas físicos no parecen ser especialmente serios. De hecho, ninguno de los tres (Valverde, Mbappé y Konaté) están descartados para el duelo ante el Villarreal del 10 de octubre. También, que parece que llegan buenas noticias desde la enfermería, con el más que probable regreso de Militao al trabajo con el grupo. El brasileño ya podría desde hoy empezar a regresar de formar parcial al trabajo con el equipo. Tal y como informó MARCA, el central recibió recientemente la visita del médico que le operó de la grave lesión del tendón que sufrió el pasado mes de abril y ha dado vía libre a su regreso a los entrenamientos con el grupo, como último paso para recibir el alta competitiva. Su regreso dependería ya de cómo vaya evolucionando con el trabajo con el resto de compañeros y el tiempo que necesite para alcanzar la mejor forma para volver a jugar, pero se le espera en octubre.

articles.title: Xavi gets first win as Netherlands boss, Denmark beat Wales
articles.summary: The Netherlands gave Xavi Hernandez his first win as head coach with a 2-1 Nations League victory over Serbia in Belgrade on Sunday, while Denmark saw off Wa...
articles.body:
The Netherlands gave Xavi Hernandez his first win as head coach with a 2-1 Nations League victory over Serbia in Belgrade on Sunday, while Denmark saw off Wales.

The Dutch were held to a 1-1 draw by Germany in Xavi's bow on Thursday, but two goals from Mexx Meerdink were enough for them to get past a spirited Serbia and move to four points from two games in Group A2.

The Oranje turned to Barcelona great Xavi after a disappointing World Cup last-32 exit at the hands of Morocco .

Serbia passed up a good opportunity to take a 17th-minute lead when Dejan Joveljic could only shoot straight at Dutch goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen when completely unmarked inside the area.

Liverpool winger Cody Gakpo then hobbled off injured in a blow to the Netherlands and was replaced by Ruben van Bommel .

But Xavi's men forged ahead on the half-hour mark as AZ Alkmaar striker Meerdink drilled in a penalty to score his first international goal after Aleksa Terzic fouled Crysencio Summerville .

Serbia coach Veljko Paunovic brought on striker Luka Jovic at half-time and the change paid off almost immediately, as the former Real Madrid man turned the ball in following a goalmouth scramble less than a minute after the restart.

But the visitors reclaimed the lead in the 69th minute as Meerdink, who made his Netherlands debut against Germany, fired a left-footed shot into the bottom corner after being played in by substitute Guus Til .

Denmark bounced back from Thursday's dramatic loss to Norway by seeing off Wales 2-0 in Copenhagen in Group A4.

The Scandinavians, who missed out on the World Cup with a penalty shoot-out defeat by the Czech Republic in the play-offs, have now won their last four meetings with Wales.

Home forward Gustav Isaksen had a first-half strike ruled out for offside, before Mikkel Damsgaard rattled a shot off the post.

The hosts went ahead eight minutes into the second period, though, when Wales skipper Ben Davies diverted Damsgaard's free-kick into his own net with his arm, under pressure from Rasmus Hojlund .

Denmark doubled their advantage 13 minutes later when Isaksen's deflected shot spun in off the crossbar after Wales, who lost their opener to Portugal , again failed to deal with a set-piece.

In League B, Austria made it two wins from two as David Affengruber , Junior Adamu and Carney Chukwuemeka scored in a 3-1 win over Kosovo in Vienna.

Later, Ireland take on Israel in Debrecen, Hungary, after a late decision to fulfil the fixture despite unease over the war in Gaza.

Since Ireland were drawn in the same Nations League group as Israel, prominent Irish figures including sportspeople, fan groups and pro-Palestinian campaigners have protested against the ties going ahead.

Ireland's designated home match against Israel on October 4 has been moved from Dublin's Aviva Stadium to Backa Topola, Serbia, following concerns over disruption and security.

articles.title: AP College Football Poll 2026 Week 5 Rankings Released with Top Risers and Fallers
articles.summary: Ole Miss' run in the top five proved to be short-lived.
articles.body:
Ole Miss' run in the top five proved to be short-lived.

The Rebels dropped five spots from fourth to ninth in the newest Associated Press Top 25 poll .

A 24-point victory over Pete Golding's squad, meanwhile, catapulted Florida up to eighth. This is the Gators' highest position in the AP poll since 2020.

Having suffered its first loss, USC is now 18th, while Penn State and Michigan fell out of the Top 25 altogether.

Texas' trip to Knoxville to play Tennessee was the biggest game on the Week 4 slate. The matchup didn't quite live up to the hype as neither team excelled, and the Longhorns were fortunate to avoid a late collapse.

Vols quarterback Faizon Brandon hit Mike Matthews for a 30-yard touchdown pass with 1:22 remaining. Tennessee recovered the ensuing onside kick and didn't need to travel far to at least get into field-goal range.

Brandon's inexperience as a true freshman got the better of him, though, as the Volunteers offense couldn't move the ball and lost precious time. Tennessee got as far as the Texas 46-yard line before Brandon's Hail Mary attempt was batted away.

For different reasons, Florida vs. Ole Miss proved to be another mostly anticlimactic affair.

Gators coach Jon Sumrall was surprised to see his team favored leading up to the game. It turns out the Vegas oddsmakers underrated the home team.

Florida was ahead by two scores at halftime and maintained that advantage for much of the second half. Jadan Baugh, who ran for 142 yards, scored the final of his three rushing touchdowns with four minutes remaining to put the finishing touches on the impressive win.

Perhaps a hangover was inevitable after Ole Miss achieved such an emotional high by beating LSU and former coach Lane Kiffin. That result may have also caused the hype surrounding the Rebels to get higher than it should've.

For Florida, a 4-0 start has raised hopes the program finally found a worthy successor to Urban Meyer after a succession of head coaches eventually flamed out.

Over in the Big Ten, Oregon repositioned itself as perhaps the strongest contender to challenge Ohio State and reigning champion Indiana for the conference title.

The Ducks went on to the road and took down USC. Allowing the Trojans to gain 446 yards was a concerning sign, but the Ducks moved the ball at will despite losing starting quarterback Dante Moore midway through the contest. Dylan Raiola came on in relief and went 19-of-25 for 289 yards and two touchdowns.

On the same day Oregon had a statement win, Penn State was upset by an unranked Wisconsin and Michigan gave up a last-second touchdown to Iowa in a 20-19 loss.

Through four games, the Wolverines simply don't look that good within a Top 25 context, and the honeymoon period is already over for Nittany Lions coach Matt Campbell.

Either school could remain in the College Football Playoff conversation once the focus starts shifting more to that. Penn State in particular has a pretty easy schedule. USC and Michigan are the toughest games the rest of the way.

But both remain clear works in progress.

On Saturday afternoon, the Texas football program improved to 4-0 on the 2026 college football season with a narrow road win over the Tennessee Volunteers.
